feature_name: Virtual agent to virtual agent direct chat transfer
summary: Dialogflow payloads can transfer a chat session directly from one virtual agent to another using the destination agent ID.
extended_definition: Dialogflow payloads can transfer a chat session directly from one virtual agent to another using the destination agent ID.

supporting_pages.title: "Standard Reports: Virtual Agent Data Sets \_|\_ Google Cloud Contact Center\
evidence_snippets: Planned Transfer Attribute Indicates when the voice virtual agent transferred the call to a human agent through planned interaction.
Transferred Interactions SUM The sum of interactions that were transferred from a live agent to the virtual agent.
For example, the value 'agent' will appear if an agent transfers to a queue that is answered by a virtual agent.
